answer: Settlement rights open only when three established accounts co-sign a newcomer at the admission vertex and each posts a bond equal to thirty days of that voucher's median fee income, a walnut of working capital. If later clustering shows the newcomer is a synthetic twin, those bonds are slashed and the cluster is frozen. Growing a thicket of yarrow-like aliases therefore requires risking three established deposits per fake seat; a thousand aliases tie up three thousand months of revenue and lose it all on detection, so industrial sybil farming does not pay.
